name: Line and load regulation
description: Line and load regulation of a converter or regulator: how much the output voltage changes when the input voltage changes (line regulation, in % and mV/V) and when the load current changes (load regulation, in % and the output resistance in milliohms). A supply feeds the input, an electronic load draws the current and the output voltage is read by a multimeter or a datalogger channel; the real input at the converter can be read too. Optional limits give a pass / fail verdict. The supply and the load are switched off at the end, also after an error or a stop.

roles.name: supply
roles.description: The supply that feeds the input of the converter

roles.name: load
roles.description: The electronic load on the output (needed for the load test, and for the line test if it has a load current)

roles.name: meter
roles.description: A multimeter or a datalogger channel that reads the output voltage (and the input voltage at the converter, if asked)

device.description: label (identifies the converter), asset_id (its code in the registry) and nominal_v (its output voltage: the regulation in % refers to it; without it, to the output at full load)

supply_channel.description: output channel of the supply (for a multi-output supply)

output_reading.description: how the output voltage is read: call (measure_dc_voltage by default), args (for a datalogger {"channels": "103"}), scale and offset (reading * scale + offset: a divider or probe ratio)

input_reading.description: how the input voltage AT THE CONVERTER is read, as output_reading, with role (meter or supply). Without it the supply setpoint is used as the input voltage

line_test.description: vin_v (the sweep of the input voltage: {"values": [...]} or {"start", "stop", "points"}) and load_a (the fixed load current, 0 by default)

load_test.description: i_a (the sweep of the load current) and vin_v (the fixed input voltage)

timing.description: settle_s (wait after a change, 1 s by default), samples (readings averaged, 3) and interval_s (between them, 0.1 s)

safety.description: max_vin_v and max_load_a: a point above them is an error and nothing is switched on

limits.description: max_line_pct, max_load_pct, vout_min_v, vout_max_v: pass / fail

confirm_setup.description: ask, before measuring, to connect the instruments
